purpose: Windows beta.96 r4 parity anchor for the current React/Vite Web Companion private Cloud SYNC contract
semanticContract: one organizer-scoped stable tournament identity; never select by name alone
GET current metadata before guarded PUT and validate cloudTournamentId/internalId
schema-7 fingerprint excludes installation/runtime/publication metadata including beta.95 checker provenance
equal => no PUT; local-only => push; cloud-only => pull; both-changed => safe three-way merge or explicit true conflict
after push, authoritative Cloud GET must fingerprint-equal the local tournament before success is reported
Desktop and Web continue the same cloudTournamentId/internalId and tournament state

windowsTransport.note: Keep the proven beta.96 r3 LocalEngine transport unchanged. Only the upstream Cloud contract/identity semantics are aligned to Web.

webFreezeComparison: Current Web main is 7 commits ahead of the beta.96 freeze-gate ancestor; the intervening files are Arbiter/UI/deploy-test scoped and do not modify the audited private Cloud SYNC contract files.
identitySchemaNote: cloud.schemaVersion=4 is identity metadata version; portable fingerprintContentSchema remains 7 and is the conflict-detection contract.

wireRoutes.snapshotWrite: PUT /api/v1/cloud/tournaments/{cloudTournamentId}/snapshot with Authorization Bearer and X-Expected-Revision
wireRoutes.create: POST /api/v1/cloud/tournaments using stable internalId as remote localKey
